Grants <stasis/>Coldsnap Grenades an extra Ability Charge, better tracking, and travel 17.5% farther and faster. 

Damaging an enemy with <stasis/>Coldsnap Grenades grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Grenade Energy gains based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Enemy Players: 7%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50%
